name: E-Commerce Domain Model - CLASS
code:
---
config:
  theme: forest
---
classDiagram
    direction LR
    class Customer {
        +String id
        +String name
        +String email
        +register() void
        +login() bool
    }
    class Order {
        +String id
        +Date createdAt
        +OrderStatus status
        +Money total
        +addItem(item) void
        +checkout() void
    }
    class OrderItem {
        +String productId
        +int quantity
        +Money unitPrice
        +subtotal() Money
    }
    class Product {
        +String id
        +String title
        +Money price
        +int stock
    }
    class Payment {
        +String id
        +Money amount
        +PaymentMethod method
        +PaymentStatus status
        +authorize() bool
        +capture() void
    }
    class Address {
        +String street
        +String city
        +String country
        +String postalCode
    }
    class OrderStatus {
        <<enumeration>>
        PENDING
        PAID
        SHIPPED
        DELIVERED
        CANCELLED
    }
    Customer "1" --> "*" Order : places
    Customer "1" --> "*" Address : has
    Order "1" *-- "*" OrderItem : contains
    OrderItem "*" --> "1" Product : refersTo
    Order "1" --> "1" Payment : paidBy
    Order ..> OrderStatus : uses
